thesis: Read exact settlement rules against authoritative public facts before prices fully reflect them.
universe: binary event contracts on Polymarket and Kalshi; exclude asset-price bets
trigger: A primary source already determines or tightly constrains an event resolving soon.
entry_rule: Quote the exact rule, source, date, timezone, and exception clauses. Explain remaining dispute risk.
exit_rule: Official settlement, price invalidation, target, or stated horizon; up to one year.
sizing_hints: Buy YES or NO with cash. Half Kelly with driver and position caps. No naked shorts.
